IRS990.Desc: Catalyst of San Diego Imperial Counties Catalyst is a nonprofit network of over 70 foundations, giving circles, individual funders, and impact investors seeking to improve outcomes for residents of San Diego and Imperial Counties. Catalyst connects and activates funders to learn, lead, and invest in our community through learning opportunities, collaborative grantmaking funds, mission-aligned fiscal sponsorship support, and by serving as a connective hub for social change in Californias Southern Border Region. The vision of Catalyst is an equitable, collaborative, and impactful social change ecosystem that improves the lives of all residents in San Diego and Imperial Counties.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 11b
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The Form 990 is reviewed by the President CEO and the board of directors is provided a copy prior to submission.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 12c
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: All Board members are required to annually acknowledge and sign the Conflict of Interest Statement. If a conflict arises the person with a conflict is not allowed to vote on the proposed transaction.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 15c
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: Annually, during Executive session of the Board of Directors meeting, the Chair presents formal review and recommended compensation adjustment, if any, to the Board for approval. Comparability data is presented and shared with the other members of the Board during both the executive session and regular board meetings to provide framework for the recommendation.
